topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I can't believe my neighbor has the nerve to start installing a fence right on our property line without even a heads-up. It’s like they think it’s fine to make decisions that affect both of us without considering my opinion or even giving me a chance to voice it. This fence is going to block my view and maybe even cut into my property—who does this person think they are? I’ve lived here longer, and I’ve always respected the boundaries. Now, all of a sudden, this is the treatment I get. I’m not just going to sit back and let this slide. I’m marching over there to set things straight, right now.
